Hi Ava / Tom —

Short answers up front:
- Yes — hosted API customers may choose a primary region for storage and request region-locking to keep persisted objects within that jurisdiction (US, EU, APAC options).
- Deletion SLA: for active tenant data we aim to complete logical deletion within 24–72 hours; for complete purging from backups and long-term snapshots the process can take up to 30 days depending on backup retention windows.

Subject: Redwood hosted API — data domicile, retention & erasure summary

Hi Ava / Tom —

Below are concise, copy-ready answers. Ive included operational notes beneath each item for audit purposes.

1) Data domicile / region locking- Short answer: Yes. Customers may designate a primary storage region at account creation (US / EU / APAC). We persist customer-provided content, embeddings, and model inputs/outputs in the chosen region. Replication: we maintain cross-availability replication only where required for the selected region's high-availability topology; cross-region replication is opt-in and requires a contractual addendum.

Operational note: Region locking is enforced by the control plane at provisioning and by the storage access layer. Requests routed to incompatible regions are rejected and logged.

2) Retention defaults and adjustable windows- Short answer: Default ephemeral workspace cache: 7 days; short-term persistent logs/metadata: 30 days; tenant analytics/usage aggregates: 365 days (configurable). Customers can request shorter retention or a tenant-level TTL via the Console or API.

Operational note: Retention windows are configurable per-tenant in the Console (Settings > Data & retention). We also support per-route caching TTLs at the API level for prompt-output caches.

3) Deletion / purge process and SLA- Short answer: Logical deletion of tenant objects via the management API is applied immediately; final removal from primary storage typically completes within 24–60 hours depending on I/O scheduling. Removal from backup snapshots and long-term replicas follows scheduled retention cycles and is expected to complete within 30 days of the delete request unless a longer contractual backup retention is agreed.

Operational note: Deletion is a multi-stage workflow: (a) mark-and-isolate, (b) purge from primary stores, (c) queue for backup compaction, (d) finalize erasure. Each stage has an audit event. We provide a deletion token and timeline in the API response for tracking.

4) Automated purge / scheduled deletion- Short answer: Yes. Customers may configure a scheduled purge policy (daily/weekly/monthly) for data categories (cache, logs, user uploads) via the Console or call the management API to create a scheduled job.

Operational note: Scheduled purge jobs run in a tenant-scoped worker pool. Jobs are tracked and produce an execution report with counts of affected objects and any failures. Reports are available in the Console and via the Audit Logs API.

5) Backups and emergency restores- Short answer: Regular backups exist for operational recovery; backup retention is configurable but defaults to 90 days for point-in-time snapshots. Restores are gated by change control and require customer authorization.

Operational note: When a tenant requests deletion, we schedule the corresponding backup compaction process. For legal holds, we can apply a temporary retention flag (requires agreement and will be logged).

6) Evidence / auditability- Short answer: We provide audit logs (readable CSV/JSON), deletion tokens, and exportable execution reports. For customers undergoing audits, we can produce a bounded evidence pack including storage manifests and compaction records.

Hi all —

Adding the API mechanics and one sample:

- Management API endpoint (logical delete): POST /v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/data:delete
  Payload: {"category":"user-uploads","filter":{"created_before":"2028-01-01T00:00:00Z"}}
  Response: {"deletion_token":"tok_abc123","queued_at":"2028-11-14T17:20:10Z","estimated_completion":"2028-11-15T02:00:00Z"}

- Scheduled purge via Console: Settings > Data & retention > Scheduled purges. Options: daily / weekly / monthly, plus pre-run dry-run and report.

- Evidence endpoints: GET /v1/audit/tenants/{tenant_id}/actions?type=deletion to fetch deletion events (CSV/JSON).

Notes on edge cases:
- If a tenant had cross-region replication enabled, an explicit cross-region purge job will run and the estimated completion may extend to 30 days due to snapshot compaction.
- For customers with regulatory hold requests, we can set a hold flag; deletion jobs will be suspended and an owner notified.
